digest.component_or_area: reconciler bridge and canary CI workflows
propositions: Bridge cron backstop schedule must change from */20 (20-minute) to uniform 40-minute cadence expressed as three cron entries with 40-minute gaps over a 2-hour cycle
Chain re-dispatch pacing must be added to sleep for the pass's own elapsed duration (capped at 900s, skipped above 1800s) before dispatching, doubling inter-invocation period to two pass durations
Canary schedule must change from hourly (0 * * * *) to 2-hourly (0 */2 * * *) and staleness alert window must double from 2 hours to 4 hours
Tests must assert uniform 40-minute gaps in three-entry cron schedule and cover paced re-dispatch branches (short elapsed, elapsed-skip threshold, unset guard)
All documentation and comments referencing */20 cadence or hourly canary must be updated to reflect new 40-minute and 2-hourly intervals
Worst-case reconcile latency and canary detection latency double; runner slot remains occupied during pacing sleep, not released
